why: Image 1 is spoiled by its motion-blurred figures, which read as faceless CG mannequins with sphere heads and rubbery limbs and give it away as a render at once. Image 2 has its own faults (empty cubbies, slightly hazy CG softness), but its warm toe-kick glow, haze in the pendant light, run of stools and deep room with a far speaker hold together as a believable night interior made with the room's own light.
